Baysyde Fancyes sells lots of earryngs wyth metal and sparkle, but yn my home vyllage, we make earryngs from gynseng lumber. They are very popular, very *rustyc*! Ys there a craftyng person here who can make them? Please? Y am lookyng forward to yt!

leves.name: Wood You Be Quiet
leves.description: A member of the fife and drum corps has approached me with concerns that his instrument practice may be a nuisance to his neighbors. To put his mind at ease─and avoid noise complaints─I should like to offer him a few lengths of ceiba lumber to help insulate his chambers.

leves.name: The Wing's Wings
leves.description: As part of our ongoing cultural exchange with Sharlayan, the Wing of Reflection has been studying the curative magicks of the sage, but these cold, sterile armaments are proving difficult to wield. Thus I challenge the skilled artisan reading this: present to me an array of nouliths that embody the spirit of the forest!

leves.name: Turali Quality
leves.description: A growing number of new residents are laying down roots in the Resplendent Quarter. Naturally, these good homes want for good furnishings, and I would like to provide. What I require for the task is none other than dark mahogany lumber─the sturdiest wood in all of Tural. With the proper care, the furniture I construct from it will last a lifetime or longer!

leves.name: Lament of the Lazylump
leves.description: Prangkobiq came to Tuliyollal to stuffseek for homeland of Earthenshire, but ended up on sandyshore, watching fish until sundip! If Mobbie is going to recline on sittyparts, she may as well reel in tastyfresh to sell for jinglyshine, yes? Would a kindly lowlander craftymake a good, strong fishstick for this hopeless lazylump?

leves.name: Bow Out
leves.description: The Landsguard is in dire need of durable longbows for archery practice, as it would seem our resident braggart snapped our entire stock in twain while attempting to demonstrate his “secret technique” to a comrade. Deliver your best bows posthaste, that our soldiers might return to their training without delay!

leves.name: Weaving a Path
leves.description: Look no further than the pillars of Morrow's Measure and you will see that every great journey, even the Dawnservant's, begins with the very first step. Likewise, even the most gifted seamstress couldn't possibly sew high-quality drapery without suitably high-quality thread! You understand, don't you? That is why I require your finest spinning wheel, that I might start a saga of my very own. The customers are waiting, my dear!

leves.name: Spear Pressure
leves.description: The Landsguard would like to request a shipment of new polearms for use in mock combat. We recently invited a visiting dragoon to take part in our training, you see, but this may have been a mistake... So formidable a warrior was he that the majority of our spears are now damaged beyond repair. In order to further hone our abilities, we humbly request that replacements be delivered at your earliest convenience.

leves.name: No Greater Treasure
leves.description: Everything's in order, and all that's left is to weigh anchor─just as soon as I snag one last souvenir. I've got a girl waiting back home, and I'd like to give her something that screams “made in Tural”! Any sort of fancy bauble will do. So long as it has heaps of Turali flair!

leves.name: Always Be Prepaired
leves.description: A great many of the Landsguard deeply admire Dawnservant Gulool Ja Ja, thus do they aspire to emulate his skill with dual blades. Unfortunately, we've received a number of reports regarding mismatched pairs amongst the practice weapons. As we continue our combatant selections for an upcoming demonstration, we have a pressing need for matching twinfangs.

leves.name: Paring Is Caring
leves.description: A fruit tree's health and happiness lies in the occasional pruning of undesirable branches─tiresome work without the proper equipment. That is why our organization aims to pair every farmer and botanist with the perfect hatchet, an arboricultural tool that is as sharp as it is comfortable to wield. Would that a master artisan could supply us with what we require.

leves.name: Ruthenium Supremium
leves.description: My brother and I run a joint business dealing in weapons of all shapes and sizes. His tent in Bayside Bevy caters to general clientele, while my tent in Wachumeqimeqi handles custom orders. Business is good, but I'm running low on ruthenium. Think you could hammer down some ore for me?

leves.name: Axes to the Maxes
leves.description: I don't know if you've heard the rumors, but they're true─my brother and I *were* the weaponsmiths who crafted Wuk Lamat's axe. Now that everyone knows, we can't make our axes fast enough! Suffering from success, one could say. We'd be much obliged if you could handle an order or two.

leves.name: Maintaining the Maintainers
leves.description: We perform daily routine checks on all dirigibles to ensure the safety of our vessels. We even make whatever ship parts we need at the landing, so new tools are always greatly appreciated─the easier to use, the better.

leves.name: Dagger Swagger
leves.description: *Finally*! An order for something that's not another vidraal-damned axe! These twin daggers will be the shiniest, most lovingly crafted blades you've ever seen─and I'd like to add just a pinch of salt. You can make something for me to reference, right?

leves.name: Bladewinner
leves.description: Apparently, news of our growing reputation has reached Sunperch, and now the palace has tasked us with crafting a ceremonial sword. The Third Promise's axe was one thing, but an order like this will cement the legacy of Hammerin' Bros. as the weaponsmith of Tuliyollal's very own Dawnservant! Let's make this the sword of the century!

leves.name: Maul Me
leves.description: Orechipping is too much troublework, so Prangkobiq gets other busytaskers to do it instead. But Prangkobiq did not thinksee that orechipping tools would become rusted with disuse... By a blinkglance, all will think Prangkobiq is a lazyschemer! Please craftmake new shinytools to secure Prangkobiq's reputation as suavecool orechipper.

leves.name: Ceremonial Teeth
leves.description: Though not without its challenges, the selection process for our demonstration is complete. It is a ceremonial display of martial talent, so we will need new twinfangs befitting the occasion. The sharpest you can manage, if you please.

leves.name: Awl Dreams Come True
leves.description: My wares sold just fine back in Shaaloani, but survivin' as a small business in the big city's no easy feat... Have you seen the stitchin' on the leatherwork here? Everyone's a dab hand at the details. I'll need somethin' better than my worn-down, old awl if I'm ever goin' to craft with the best of them.

leves.name: Don't Bore Me, Ore Me
leves.description: Because my brother and I forge a wide variety of weapons, we often find ourselves low on materials. And so we turn to the Pelupelu and their merchants, who love to talk us into some deal or another. If I have to hear one more smooth sales pitch, I may be tempted to use my hammer for ill. For the sake of peace in Tuliyollal's markets, might I ask for a delivery of ingots? Crafted quietly, if you please!

leves.name: Shielding My Students
leves.description: I am Br'uk Br'aax, monument to physical training and terror to new recruits. My purpose is to bequeath the burning spirit of the Landsguard upon all who would accept it. Thus, I require a shield worthy of the Landsguard name, one that will humble even the most foolhardy novice.

leves.name: Brace for More Vambraces
leves.description: A rising star of the Landsguard just placed a special order for vambraces. Strictly speaking, it's a personal request; Landsguard coffers aren't deep enough to account for individual preferences. But once the other soldiers see these beauties, my guess is orders will come pouring in. I reckon it never hurts to be prepared, so could I trouble you for a pair?

leves.name: Forgiveness for My Shins
leves.description: My magnificent shield is impervious to the flimsy attacks of new recruits. Yet one stands defiant and, by either foolishness or cunning, strikes at my shins. It hurts! I now require a pair of sabatons if my lessons are to continue.

leves.name: Metal with Mettle
leves.description: The Wing of Reflection wants us to participate in collaborative research. We've been asked to create the hardest ingot we can manage in order to determine which Turali ore is strongest. If we can make something that rivals Yok Huy architecture for toughness, we might well be reviving the lost art of Turali metalwork!

leves.name: Odd Instruments
leves.description: Preparing medicinal herbs by our traditional practices requires little more than a quernstone, but I've recently taken an interest in foreign medicine. Alchemy across the salt, for instance, demands a number of odd instruments that cannot be readily found at market. Could you create me precision tools with which to perform my studies?

leves.name: Don't Ask about the Rivets
leves.description: I've only just opened shop here in the capital, but I've already gotten an awfully bizarre request for a black riveted mask that covers the entire head. ...I'm not about to judge, but these big city folk sure have interestin' tastes. Do you think you could fix me somethin' to reference?

leves.name: Backing up My Words
leves.description: Thwarted by my shield and sabatons, my sweet students now attack me from behind! They heed my wisdom well and constantly seek weakness in their quarry. Yet now that quarry suffers from back pain─I shall need some of that spiked armor that all the fashionable warriors are wearing. Then I will be truly invincible.

leves.name: A Hand for a Deckhand
leves.description: Any sailor worth his salt is a master of ropework. Only, when yer at sea for moons on end, ye can't help but long fer a pair of sturdy gloves what can keep yer hands from chafin'. The wind and water can sting somethin' wicked... Ye think you could help me out?

leves.name: Essays on Equipment
leves.description: Passionate though they are for martial training, our members show little concern towards maintaining their kit. Leg armor purchased just recently is now unfit for use due to neglect and carelessness. Those responsible have been assigned essays on the importance of equipment maintenance, but we require replacements for the damaged armor nonetheless.

leves.name: On Board for Lar
leves.description: Quality metal is in high demand these days due to all the development they're doing in Xak Tural with foreign technologies. I'm bound to make good coin if I specialize, so I need as many Lar ingots as you can manage.

leves.name: Pendulums of Our Own
leves.description: In accordance with our study of healing techniques used by foreign sages, the Wing of Reflection currently hopes to develop nouliths whose energy transmissions are comparable to foreign models. We would be much obliged to the artisan who can craft us a weapon of Sharlayan design, but made of Turali metal.

leves.name: Guaranteed Gem
leves.description: Y come from deep yn the countrysyde, so Y'm not used to sellyng wares yn a cyty lyke Tulyyollal. My boss tells me my accent ys too strong and that customers don't understand when Y explayn complycated products. But yhuykanyte always sells, so please make me some yhuykanyte!

leves.name: Fan of the Foreign
leves.description: The sword, the lance, the bow─an instructor must be versed in all manner of weaponry. But the other day, I saw an adventurer from across the salt wielding a fan made of metal. What fascinating innovation! I, too, must learn how to defeat my foes with a pair of metal fans.

leves.name: Shiny and Good
leves.description: A customer came askyng for somethyng specyal to gyve theyr sweetheart, but Y don't know the fyrst thyng about what cyty people lyke... Maybe somethyng wyth pynk beryl yn yt? Yt's so sparkly that anyone would love yt! Could you polysh me some pynk beryls, please?

leves.name: Sew Excited
leves.description: Thanks to increased communication with foreign nations, our selection of available materials has grown immensely. You can imagine our joy as seamsters─so many gorgeous fabrics! I simply must have new tools with which to express my passion.

leves.name: Orders Anonymous
leves.description: Y don't understand thys next order. An anonymous clyent wants a spyky mask that covers the mouth? Maybe Y heard wrong...unless thys ys the heyght of Tulyyollal fashyon!? Y hope you can make thys, because Y could never...

leves.name: Ringing Gratitude
leves.description: The Resplendent Quarter's previous chairman provided us with many long years of service, heralding back to our district's inaugural years. Our committee has decided to commission a commemorative ring as a small token of our thanks. I believe something made in white gold will be well received.

leves.name: The Right Rod
leves.description: We wish to equip our arcane practitioners with quality instruments that meet their various needs. There is a particular dark steel not typically used in Tural which I believe would be well suited for our traditional divinatory practices. We would be much indebted to the artisan able to create us such a rod.

leves.name: Mask Maker
leves.description: Another order for a byzarre mask... Y dydn't thynk Baysyde Fancyes catered to that sort of thyng, but you learn a lot yn the byg cyty. Thys tyme the mask ys made of a shyny stone called “black star.” Looks lyke a pyece of the future, yf that makes any sense. Yt may be our fancyest pyece yet!

leves.name: Tenets of Tanning
leves.description: I may have just opened up shop, but I'm no stranger to the tenets of leatherworkin'. The skin we use is a precious gift from the livin' creature it came from, and as a proud Hhetsarro, it's my duty to honor its sacrifice. Which is to say, I'd appreciate help with my tannin', so long as whoever does it fully understands the responsibility.

leves.name: The Perfect Accessory
leves.description: My byg brother ys a leatherworker, so Y often suggest leather pyeces to my own customers. No matter who you are or what you wear, a chyc leather bracelet wyll always fyt your style. Workyng yn sales has never been so easy! Can you make me somethyng lyke that? Somethyng daryng?

leves.name: Freezing Fingers
leves.description: A dirigible only arrives at its destination by the skill and precision of its pilot. As our vessels can reach freezing altitudes, we must take care that our pilots' hands don't go numb with cold. Could you make us something sturdy enough to block the wind, but that still allows for precision?

leves.name: Dreams of Ja
leves.description: I just got a Tonawawta customer askin' for an outfit that'll make them look like a Mamool Ja. Before you ask─I don't question, I just do my job. I'm thinkin' I can make a mask out of crocodileskin, but the detailin' will take some time. If you could make some leggin's to match, I'd be much obliged.

leves.name: Respect for Br'aax
leves.description: People of the Xbr'aal honor the br'aax as one of Tural's most outstandin' creatures. Processin' such an important skin requires time, consideration, and skill. While I don't lack for any of these things, I'd be grateful for an extra pair of hands to help replenish my stock.

leves.name: Lending Artisans a Hand
leves.description: Povlu's Peddlery endeavors to meet the needs of patrons in all corners of the continent, our trade routes and outposts like the vast network of roots in a dense jungle! Tural is home to myriad artists who create works of the highest quality, and I believe such masterful hands are deserving of masterfully crafted gloves.

leves.name: Freezing Toes
leves.description: Our pilots complain not only of cold hands, but cold feet as well. Considering how long they spend stationary at the helm, it's little wonder we hear grumbling about frigid toes. Supposedly, a popular new style of boot seen around the city is ideal for the job, and so we'd like to supply our pilots with a few pairs.

leves.name: Giving Gatherers Their Gear
leves.description: With diverse clientele comes diverse needs, especially when you consider the particularities of each culture. But all peoples of Tural have one thing in common─a reliance upon the bounties of nature. That's why gear for gatherers is guaranteed to sell well, and we're always keen to replenish our stock!

leves.name: Worqor Zormor or Bust
leves.description: I received an order for shoes from a traveler plannin' a solo expedition to the top of Worqor Zormor. Seems to me like winnin' over the Yok Huy would be more important than commissionin' a pair of shoes, but that's no business of mine. I think linin' the inside with gargantua leather should make 'em comfortable enough for a climb.

leves.name: Just Generally Freezing
leves.description: We've given them new gloves and new boots, but now our pilots say they want new *clothes*! ...I suppose they've been enduring the cold without complaint for a while now. If we could provide them with something made of gargantua leather, I'm sure it would make all the difference. It had better, anyway...

leves.name: Comfy Cabins
leves.description: Since we began hosting Sunperch's honored guests, our humble establishment has achieved new repute. As such, we aspire to furnish our rooms with the finest of luxuries, and our bedclothes are no exception. Cloth made from Urqopacha snow cotton should be just what we require.

leves.name: Begin with the Basics
leves.description: Our shop has long upheld its prestigious reputation as the palace's personal tailors. Before we entrust any of our orders to outside artisans, we must first ensure a basic level of quality can be met. Create me a simple cotton jacket─and be aware that not a single stitch will go without scrutiny.

leves.name: Cloth for Canvas
leves.description: My work in painting myriad landscapes takes me to every corner of Tural, but the rural settlements I visit often have nothing in the way of canvases. I've taken to preparing my own panels, but I find myself short on fabric. If an artisan would be kind enough to weave me a fine linen for my paintings, I would be deeply grateful.

leves.name: In Line with Linen
leves.description: Our previous request was filled to satisfaction, so next we would test our candidates for style. One of our shop's most coveted items is an airy cloak made of linen. We ask that this piece be recreated with a particular attention to the full-body silhouette.

leves.name: Weaving the Envelope
leves.description: Weight is a primary concern when it comes to dirigibles, which means all our materials must be both light and strong. Additionally, the envelope's fabric must be airtight─not to mention resistant to open flame. We can treat the fabric for the latter, but we need an expert weaver to prepare us a sufficient amount of fine sarcenet cloth.

leves.name: Traditional Trousers
leves.description: Now I would like to test candidates on their understanding of traditional Turali clothing. Weavers in our employ must not only demonstrate peerless needlework, but also a deep understanding of our culture. Create a pair of bottoms from sarcenet cloth that proves your knowledge and dedication to our history.

leves.name: Halfgloves, Full Effort
leves.description: A large order is due to arrive from the palace, so I must soon select candidates to assist us with this work. As a final challenge, I would have artisans create a pair of halfgloves woven from the wool of a Turali beast.

leves.name: Cruel Climates
leves.description: Xak Tural is home to unforgiving climates, so gatherers must take extra care when preparing their gear. Our most common requests are for durable, comfortable, and warm clothing, so I think something made from rroneek wool will do nicely.

leves.name: Glamorous Gloves
leves.description: Povlu's Peddlery caters to a wide range of clientele─we even fill orders from the palace on occasion! Our latest request is for a pair of fine silk gloves for some ceremony or another. We thought to entrust this task to an artisan with ample experience.

leves.name: Silk for Sunperch
leves.description: The time has finally come to fulfill our order from Sunperch. We will be preparing ceremonial outfits of silk, and while our own tailors will create the necessary gloves and breeches, select artisans will be commissioned to fashion the overcoats. Only garments that embody both beauty and perfection shall be accepted.

leves.name: Fast-forwarding Flora
leves.description: To better support the health of our nation's leaders, we regularly incorporate the knowledge of foreign practices in our research. Our latest endeavor requires a suitable growth reagent to confirm the effects of our medicinal flora. Would you be able to provide such a thing?

leves.name: Big Brush, Big Dreams
leves.description: I was walking through the capital the other day when I saw a young lady carrying a giant brush across her back. What kind of art does one create with such a tool? I must try it for myself. If you could craft me a large angle brush, I would be much obliged.

leves.name: Binding Spells
leves.description: The Wing of Reflection has seen fit to task the Nest of Learning with adapting tomes of foreign arcanists to suit our needs, which includes rebinding with local materials. As few experts in the creation of foreign tomes conduct business in Tuliyollal, we are petitioning the support of individual artisans who possess the skill and dedication required for such a task.

leves.name: For Tired Minds
leves.description: Day in and day out, our leaders deliberate over the future of this nation, and it is evident their minds grow weary from the effort. As the palace apothecary, I wish to do my part to support them alongside my colleagues, and so I would like to commission a concoction that enhances mental acuity.

leves.name: I Like Big Brush and I Cannot Lie
leves.description: The giant brush I commissioned is predictably not suited for detail work, but its large strokes are ideal for more direct expressions of emotion. I may be on the verge of discovering a new personal style, and so I would next try my hand at painting with a round brush.

leves.name: Cutting Edge of Culinary Quality
leves.description: Every dish we place upon the tables of Vollok Shoonsa must be unmatched in flavor and flawless in presentation. Which is to say, our chefs' knives should slice with peerless precision! We are in need of whetstones capable of accommodating such exacting standards.

leves.name: All-night Crafting
leves.description: Some of the divinatory rituals performed at the palace require the production of arcane instruments in considerable quantities. The artisans tasked with their creation often work through the night, and so I would like to offer them support in the way of an alchemical potable.

leves.name: Something Salty and Ceremonial
leves.description: The leather-bound grimoires we commissioned have proven popular with our mages, and all have expressed eager interest in foreign geometries. We now have a need for books fit for ceremonial purposes─that is to say, books as beautiful as they are practical. A taste of salt would also not go amiss.

leves.name: Tome for Tradition
leves.description: As a representative of the Wing of Reflection and keeper of the Nest of Learning, it gladdens me to see our collection of books grow. We've received another order, this time for a tome to be used in the palace. It should go without saying that what we require is a masterwork, pages resilient enough to be passed down through the ages as our nation continues to flourish and prosper. Naught less will suffice for a request from the Dawnservant.

leves.name: Remedy for Reason
leves.description: The Vow of Reason is always expected to make rational decisions that shape the very fate of our nation. Such a burden surely invites great worry, which is why I would offer him a tonic to soothe both mind and spirit.

leves.name: More Mezcal
leves.description: There's simply no cooking my tacos without mezcal. It's key to the meat's savory flavor! I use just enough that even those averse to drinking still love my tacos, but they sell quickly, and I fear I may run out of mezcal. I would be forever thankful to anyone who can replenish Aunt Tii's supply.

leves.name: Friends Are Food
leves.description: You may know alpacas as sweet companions on the road, but they sweeten a Turali dinner table just as well as any other meat. We make it a point to honor every part of a creature's life, you see, whether in service or as sustenance. The Pelupelu often eat us out of stock, so we always appreciate extra hands in preparing alpaca dishes.

leves.name: Don't Knock It Till You've Tried It
leves.description: Travelers from across the salt are regularly shocked by our swampmonk. It's not a meat that sounds appetizing, but when you trap its natural flavors in a mezcal marinade, it makes an addictively delicious dish. Help us fill our orders and you'll see what I mean.

leves.name: Not-so-secret Ingredient
leves.description: Our tacos' secret ingredient is royal maple syrup. Why share the secret? Because only the truly skilled can make tacos that rival ours. The syrup's rich sweetness enhances the meat and spices, making it an invaluable ingredient I use daily. I'd greatly appreciate a replenishing of our stock.

leves.name: Simple Is Hardest
leves.description: Xbalyav Ty'e is known for more than its odder entrees─in fact, our most popular dish is a modification of a simple foreign pasta. Of course, the simpler the dish, the more scrutiny falls upon the skills of its chef. Can you make a peperoncino that can satisfy our customers' discerning tastes?

leves.name: Creative Chocolate
leves.description: In Tural, we mainly use kukuru beans for beverages, but I hear that across the salt, chocolate has advanced the creation of confectionary to a surprising degree. I believe something like that might be suitable for our tables. The embrace of a chewy crust around a decadent center...a union of bitter and sweet... I trust you can create something like that for me to emulate?

leves.name: Bring Me Your Tacos
leves.description: Thanks to the city's support, Aunt Tii's Tacos has been named one of Tuliyollal's most popular food stands! But to remain popular in a city filled with taco-lovers, one must humbly continue to study and grow. That's why I'd like to sample the tacos of any and all who feel confident in their culinary talents. Go on, put me to shame if you can!

leves.name: Najoothie
leves.description: In honor of Dawnservant Gulool Ja Ja's Mamook heritage, we ensure that dishes featuring Ja Tiika bananas are always available at the palace. Of particular popularity is the smoothie we offer each morning, so we would like to request a beverage of comparable taste and quality.

leves.name: Sweet, Sweet Bean Juice
leves.description: Aunt Tii's Tacos also offers drinks, but finding flavors to match so many taco combinations is harder than you might think. That's when Aunt Tii had a brilliant revelation─a juice as sweet as alpaca's milk and pressed from mesquite beans would be guaranteed to refresh and satisfy!

leves.name: Ocean Explosion
leves.description: Of all our offerings, I'm most proud of my acqua pazza─a dish bursting with the bounties of the ocean. It sells well, I'm pleased to say, but I simply don't have time to personally prepare each dish. You seem to handle yourself well enough in a kitchen, so can I ask you to take a few plates off my hands?
